notes.title: Korean & Simplified Chinese Languages Added!
notes.content:
[p]Hello detectives,[/p][p][/p][p]We are proud to share that Duck Detective now officially supports Simplified Chinese and Korean![/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate, both games are on their biggest discounts to date, so it's better than ever to quack some mysteries![/p][p][/p][p]Translating a mystery full of wordplay is never easy, but we’re thrilled that even more players can now deduckt mysteries in their own language. [/p][p]
We also want to give a special thank you to everyone who created early [b]fan translations[/b], your hard work helped pave the way for these official localizations and brought Duck Detective to new audiences from the very beginning.
[/p][p][/p][p]Check out this wonderful fanart created by [i][u][url="https://www.instagram.com/ogaelfox?igsh=dnkyZnBrZmduZTZl&utm_source=qr"]Victoria Luberda[/url][/u][/i]:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779292/0b43f4bc6077ca6f0895fe3dced9470d6bfb3d12.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to all of you for your continued amazing support[/p][p]~Happy Broccoli Team[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2637990/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: New Duck Detective game announced!!
notes.content:
Hi investigators :) 

Big news! Big, exciting news!! We have finally announced the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2714620/]next Duck Detective game[/url]. It’s called ‘The Ghost of Glamping’, and it’ll be out next year!

When spookiness strikes a luxury campsite, the one and only Duck Detective is summoned to quack the case. Inspect evidence, make de-duck-tions, and solve a no-murder mystery in this new standalone instalment of the beloved mystery puzzle series.

[previewyoutube=YSen3srIrHQ;full][/previewyoutube]

This is another short fun adventure just like The Secret Salami, but with a new cast and storyline. Also, Eugene McQuacklin is now joined by a partner, much to his annoyance. Will the famed Detective escape the shadows of his past and nibble at the crumbs of justice?

Sappy corner: When we launched The Secret Salami earlier this year, we had no idea what we were in for. Would people like it? Was the whole idea too silly? How many duck puns can someone put up with in one game, anyway? The answers were yes, probably, and lots. The response to Duck Detective was more than our highest hopes and we are so excited to be diving back into another mystery with you all!! 

See you soon!

Best,

The Happy Broccoli Team

notes.title: German Language & Workshop Support Update!
notes.content:
Hello detectives,

We have two wonderful pieces of news!

We have added [b]German [/b]language support to Duck Detective, and we have also added Steam Workshop support so new unofficial translations can be added!

Localising the game ended up being a lot more work than we initially thought - it's very tricky translating deducktions to new languages. 

[b][i]HOWEVER[/i][/b]

We want to give you all the opportunity to enjoy Duck Detective in more languages so we have an extra surprise! 

We have added [b]Steam Workshop support[/b] to the game so anyone in the community can create translations!!

[b]Korean [/b]has already been included as a language in the workshop! A [i][b]big [/b][/i]thank you to [b]Ashtokki [/b]for providing their fan translation and helping iron out bugs with the workshop tools:

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3333408741

To anyone interested, here you can find a guide on how to get started with localizing the game:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3330385097

To celebrate the EGGcellent update we are doing our largest discount ever at [b]20% off[/b], so if you were on the fence, now is the best time to pick up the game! Buy it for a friend, overworked colleague, or estranged lover! There can never be enough duck in a person's life

Also check out this amazing fan-art of Eugene's office by [url=https://x.com/redux3d]Redux3d[/url] :

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779292/5a1e6244b76bc983cc69e66d236aa05b6cc6d6e4.jpg[/img]

Also we are going to have a limited run physical edition on Switch starting 26th September! It comes with some exclusive Duck Detective content including never before seen early concepts of the game. Can find more info here: https://superraregames.com/



Thanks to all of you for your amazing support, and stay tuned for more cool updates that are in the works

~Happy Broccoli Team

notes.title: The DuckSide Detective Bundle!
notes.content:
[b]We have some news, detectives!![/b]

The Duck Detective is now available in a bundle with the fantastic Darkside Detective.
We're honestly big fans of the game, so we're extremely excited!

[b]So what exactly is Darkside Detective?[/b]

Welcome to Twin Lakes - America’s 34th most haunted city. Grab your trench coat, tune your sixth sense, and join the Darkside Division as they investigate the outright bizarre, downright dangerous, and often confusing cases of Twin Lakes.

Domesticated gremlins, undead mafians, interdimensional trains and other inglorious cases get dumped on their desks as, for better or worse, they are the first and last line of defence against things that go bump in the night (things that go bump during the day are the jurisdiction of another department).

Check it out here:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43383/The_Duckside_Detective/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779292/fdbd196e4fa8a2e1a364fb4b8f22b53ff1a0b909.png[/img]

notes.title: THE DUCK IS SOARING, THANKS TO YOU!
notes.content:
Hello detectives,

It's only been 1 weekend and we have already hit overwhelmingly positive!

Thank you all so so much for playing the game, the response has definitely been overwhelming and positive for us too. We really never expected that such a small, silly, adventure would connect with so many people, so we are really grateful to all of you that have given Mr McQuacklin a chance!

We can tell people are excited for future adventures of Eugene, however, we really don't want to count our chickens before they have hatched so we're taking some time now to work out will come next, and we promise that we will come to you all with super cool announcements when we are ready!

notes.title: The Duck Detective Demo is here!
notes.content:
Hello friends!

Good news of you who’ve been excited to get their flippers on our gentle mystery game Duck Detective: The Secret Salami. The game isn’t ready to launch just yet, but we’ve got a free demo in the Steam Next Fest, starting TODAY(!) and running until February 12th. 

The demo is 10-15 minutes long and gives a good snapshot into the life of Eugene McQuacklin – duck, detective, and downtrodden divorcee. His life may be crumbling like stale bread on an old park bench, but that won’t stop him from waddling towards the truth!

As ever, if you like the game we’d encourage you to give it a wishlist and tell your friends. We’ll be back soon with more exciting news.

Thanks so much for your support!

– The Happy Broccoli team <3
